attempts.raw: {"risk": 3, "reason": "Beyond just pinning Vue/vue-multiselect/vuedraggable versions in resource manifests, the PR also swaps the AdminMenu node list script from the bundled admin-menu.min.js to an unrelated asp-name=\"jQuery.nestedSortable\" resource and drops depends-on=\"admin\" from two style tags, which are unrelated scope-creep changes that could silently break admin menu drag-reorder functionality or CSS load order across all tenants using these built-in Vue-based field editors."}
